# T-2: Apply force teardown

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make `finalize-cleanup --force` pass force semantics to dirty worktree removal for root-file and initialized-submodule dirty states.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `--force` invokes git worktree removal with force semantics when dirty root files remain.
- `--force` invokes force removal for initialized submodule dirtiness rather than returning the non-force dirty halt.
- Non-force cleanup keeps the existing dirty-state halt and recovery envelope behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Preserve orphan-drop audit behavior while extending force semantics to the worktree removal boundary.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests should cover removeWorktreeForCleanup or the command path with dirty root and submodule-like failure conditions.
